# MTPLX sets model, model_provider, web_search, model_context_window and [model_providers.mtplx] on each launch; everything else here is kept.
model = "mtplx-qwen38-flash-next-optimized-speed"
model_provider = "mtplx"
web_search = "disabled"
model_context_window = 262144
model_reasoning_effort = "medium"

[model_providers.mtplx]

base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
http_headers = { "x-mtplx-client" = "codex" }
